name: vg-brain-capture
description: Voyageur Group: VG Brain autosave. A restricted plugin, kept in its own marketplace so it never appears in the plugin list of people who should not have it.

plugins.name: vg-brain-capture
plugins.description: VG Brain autosave: uploads every Claude Code session to your OWN notes (session end, before a compact, catch-up), loads your brain context at session start, and sets the VG Assistant output style. No brain tools: those come from the VG Brain connector. Install on its own; uninstall the old vg-brain plugin.
